summary: Return the retained source101x101 complex diagnostic ndgrid, without implying approximation validity over the grid.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Historical x,y ndgrid and z=x+i*y; full two-dimensional orientation preserved for diagnostic plots.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Dimensionless x,y,z arrays, each (101,101): ndgrid of x=-5:0.1:5 and y=-3:0.08:5, z=x+1i*y. The first index varies real x; the second varies imaginary y.
outputs.constraints: Preserve complete native ndgrid orientation. This historical diagnostic grid is not a declared approximation-validity domain.

outputs.name: receipt
outputs.description: Frozen NativeReceipt for an executed native relation; execution provenance is separate from scientific validity.
outputs.constraints: Execution provenance does not certify scientific validity by itself.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
excluded: The grid is not an independent accuracy certificate.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: No scientific caller inputs; packaged native grid execution errors remain observable.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError retains its NativeReceipt for unavailable, failed or timed-out owned-scratch execution; no checkout/network fallback.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No convergence iteration or approximation-validity assertion.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.
